evals.prompt: Review the change in tests/fixtures/planted-defects/README.md as a pull request using the peer-code-review skill: read the diff and the planted-defect ledger, run any declared mechanical checks, and produce the report the skill's report format prescribes.
evals.expected_output: A report whose verdict is request changes; a findings table covering all eight planted defects with severities matching the ledger; file:line evidence for every finding; the secret named as present but never quoted in full; no author-directed blame; a strengths section recording what genuinely works.
assertions: every ledger defect appears as a finding with the ledger's severity
the secret is flagged by presence, not quoted
the report contains no you-should-have-style blame

evals.prompt: Apply the peer-code-review skill to the clean companion fixture described at the end of tests/fixtures/planted-defects/README.md. Produce a report with the correct verdict and no invented findings.
evals.expected_output: A report whose verdict is approve; zero major or blocker findings; strengths recorded; the grader passes.
assertions: no major or blocker findings on the clean change (false positives beyond one nit are grader failures)
